mission.cluster: ResearchIR and protocol freeze, the research contract, and the research role/command vocabulary

referenceTypes: src/shared/research-ir.ts (ResearchState, ResearchIR) — the only import in the donor set, and only as a type
adaptation: TypeScript -> plain ESM JavaScript, Node 24, no dependencies. Every donor function and constant keeps its name, its string literals, its default values and its ordering; the file split mirrors the donor's own file boundaries (`ir.mjs`, `protocol.mjs`, `contract.mjs`, `roles.mjs`, `command.mjs`) with `contracts.mjs` holding the frozen vocabularies and the value shapes.

The donor's type-only declarations become frozen runtime vocabularies in `contracts.mjs`: the ResearchState union (16 main states + 4 control states) is RESEARCH_MAIN_STATES / RESEARCH_CONTROL_STATES / RESEARCH_STATES, and the inline unions become AUTONOMY_MODES, PROVIDER_POLICIES, BASELINE_PROVENANCE_KINDS, CITATION_POLICIES, RESEARCH_ROLE_NAMES, RESEARCH_ARTIFACT_KINDS, RESEARCH_PURPOSES. The donor's already-named arrays (RESEARCH_MAIN_STATES, AUTO_FIXABLE_FIELDS, FROZEN_FIELDS) are copied member for member in the donor's order.

All value shapes are copy-on-construct factories and every one of them is the single validation gate: `researchBudget`, `researchScope`, `researchIR`, `researchProtocol`, `protocolAmendment`, `researchContract`, `researchCommandSpec`. Each validates against the donor's own rules (same conditions, same order, same error text), then returns a new object; a factory never repairs invalid input into valid input.

The donor's standalone validators keep their signatures and stay void: `validateResearchIR`, `validateAmendment`, `validateCommandSpec`. In the donor they were called imperatively before using a value; here they delegate to the matching factory, so the gate and the validator cannot disagree.

`research-roles.ts`'s two private records (`STAGE_ROLE`, `STAGE_ARTIFACT`) become frozen objects with the donor's exact 20 entries; `RESEARCH_ROLES` becomes `RESEARCH_ROLE_NAMES` and the `ResearchArtifactKind` union becomes `RESEARCH_ARTIFACT_KINDS`, both in the donor's declaration order.

Injectables and defaults: `hashProtocol(protocol, hash)` keeps the injected digest (the donor had no built-in hasher); `stageArtifact(input, now = new Date(0).toISOString())` keeps the donor's deterministic epoch default verbatim. The module reads no clock, generates no id, opens no file, and touches no environment.

`inferBaselineProvenance` keeps the donor's two heuristic token lists, their order, and the three exact reason strings, including the fallback 0.5 with explicit provenance and the declared-but-unusable fallback to `implementation-declared`.
knownDifferences: No research supervisor, no run persistence, no protocol store, no provider call and no experiment execution: those are explicitly out of scope. This module is pure; it decides and describes, and the existing `evidence-engine` module owns evidence, which is never re-implemented or re-exported here.

`researchContract` is a new validation rung the donor did not have: the donor accepted any object and failed later inside a section prompt or an audit, and there was no `validateResearchContract`. UTOPIA validates the declared shape at the module boundary with named messages. Inputs the donor would have accepted and then mishandled are now refused; a well-formed contract is accepted and behaves identically.

`researchProtocol` is likewise a new shape gate for the frozen protocol document (five scientific-core fields must be strings). The donor had no protocol validator at all. `scientificCore` and `diffProtocol` deliberately keep the donor's lenient reading and do not call it.

`executableAllowed` keeps the donor's `toLocaleLowerCase()` call, so the allow-list comparison follows the host locale exactly as the donor's did; no locale is forced and none is read from the environment.

`research-ir.ts`'s `ResearchIR` fields the donor never validates (`protocolHash`, `researchQuestions`, `hypotheses`, `createdAt`, `updatedAt`) are copied rather than judged, and `researchQuestions`/`hypotheses` default to `[]` when absent, matching how every donor consumer reads them.
`validateResearchIR`, `validateAmendment` and `validateCommandSpec` return nothing (the donor returned `void`); the factories are what return the validated copy.
No ported file imports anything outside this directory and none imports `evidence-engine`.

vectors: RESEARCH_MAIN_STATES is the donor's 16 states in plan order, followed by the control states RECOVERING / WAITING_FOR_PROVIDER / WAITING_FOR_USER / FAILED
RESEARCH_NEXT is the donor table exactly, keyed in vocabulary order, with READY->READY, FAILED->FAILED and each control state returning to SCOPING
nextResearchState is null for FAILED and READY, null for a control state unless allowControl is true, and the table lookup otherwise
canAdvance is false only for FAILED, READY, WAITING_FOR_PROVIDER and WAITING_FOR_USER

the IR gate refuses with exactly: Invalid research IR id / Research goal must be 1–20000 characters / Research requires a workspace / Invalid allowedDomains / Research requires 1–5 reviewers / Invalid autonomy mode / Invalid research budget / Invalid research state / Invalid pending research stage
a pendingStage must be a main state; a control state is a valid `state` but never a valid `pendingStage`
canonicalStableProtocol sorts keys recursively for objects, maps arrays in order, and delegates leaves to JSON.stringify
hashProtocol hashes the canonical text through the injected digest
scientificCore is the five fixed keys plus `exclusion-rule` only when the protocol's exclusionRule is truthy
diffProtocol reports a silent change only for a frozen field the candidate core defines and that differs; changedMechanical is always empty

the amendment gate refuses with exactly: Amendment requires an id / Amendment requires the frozen protocol hash / Amendment requires changes / Amendment touches non-frozen field: <field> / Amendment change requires a reason

inferBaselineProvenance honours a finite declared baseline, defaults an unknown source to implementation-declared, matches proportion tokens case-insensitively to 0.5/random-chance, error tokens to 0/host-heuristic, and otherwise keeps 0.5/host-heuristic with the donor's reason text
a section prompt is the donor's exact template, joins hypotheses with '; ', and requires a claim when the claim statement contains the section name or the section name contains 'method'
violatesContract refuses with 'empty section', then 'section must not rewrite the frozen research goal' for the four donor patterns, case-insensitively

the sufficiency gate requires the 24-character evidence prefix or the claim id in evidenceRefs, runsPerHypothesis × max(1, hypotheses.length) executed experiments while printing the unclamped product, one traceable citation unless the policy is manual, and one completed review; open criticism is retained in notes and never blocks
every one of the 20 stages routes to the donor role and expects the donor artifact kind; an unknown stage yields undefined rather than a refusal

stageArtifact derives its id as '<stage lowercased>:<now with : and . replaced by ->', truncates the summary to 500 characters, defaults evidenceRefs to [] and defaults now to the deterministic 1970-01-01T00:00:00.000Z epoch

the command gate refuses with exactly: Research command requires an executable / Research executable must be a bare path/name (no shell metacharacters) / Invalid research args / Research command requires a cwd / Invalid research purpose / Invalid research timeout / Invalid expected outputs, with args capped at 100 items of 4000 characters, timeoutMs between 1000 and 3600000, and expectedOutputs capped at 20 items of 500 characters
executableAllowed strips a leading path and a .exe/.cmd/.bat suffix, compares lower-cased against the donor's 11-name allow-list, and is NOT part of the command gate
